name: savings_balancing_lns
thought: Construct initial solution using deterministic Clarke-Wright savings algorithm, merging until exactly truck_count routes remain. Then iteratively reduce maximum route distance by relocating customers from the longest route to other routes, swapping customers between routes, and applying 2-opt on each route. When local search plateaus, apply ruin-recreate: remove up to 3 customers from the longest route and reinsert them using regret-2 insertion. All operations are deterministic (tie-breaking by smaller index) and bounded by instance size. Report new best solutions via report_best_vrp.
